Title: 494857-2026: France – Construction of roads with two carriageways – Upgrading the RD178 to 2x2 lanes and insertion of a reserved lane between Viais and the A83 - Earthworks, engineering structures, drainage, pavement and equipment (TOACE)
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Road construction with mention of 'ouvrages d'art' (bridges/structures) in France; of interest for sbp if larger or complex bridge components are included. This is not evident from the title and short description, therefore medium relevance.
titel: Upgrading the RD178 to 2x2 lanes and installation of a reserved lane between Viais and the A83 – earthworks, engineering structures, drainage, pavement and equipment
kurzbeschreibung: Road widening with engineering structures and drainage between Pont-Saint-Martin and Les Sorinières.
umfang: Road construction project to upgrade the RD178 to four lanes with a reserved lane between Viais and the A83. Includes earthworks, engineering structures, drainage, pavement construction, safety barriers, noise barriers and equipment. The notice does not state specific information on the number of bridges, spans or structural dimensions.
leistungen: Construction services for road construction and associated engineering structures; earthworks, ouvrages d'art, assainissement, chaussée and equipements; possible later award of similar services.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Focus is a construction tender for road works, not for planning or structural design services.
• Engineering structures are included, but without information on spans, structural types or particular structural complexity.
• No explicit planning component such as structural design, conceptual design or HOAI-like services is apparent.
• Generally only of limited relevance for sbp, as road construction and execution dominate.
• Positive is that price is not the sole deciding factor and quality and sustainability criteria are taken into account.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the notice. Essential information such as route length, number and size of engineering structures, quantities for earthworks, pavement structure and drainage is missing for a reliable estimate. Due to the multi-year execution period from 03/2027 to 12/2029 and the scope, it can be assumed to be a larger infrastructure project, but a serious euro estimate cannot be derived from the available information.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee information is available. As this is a construction tender without explicit planning services for structural or object design, an sbp-relevant fee cannot be derived from the notice.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Indication of the average annual number of employees and management staff over the last three years; list of works carried out over the last five years with certificates of satisfactory execution for the main projects; declaration of total turnover and contract-related turnover for the last three financial years; self-declaration on exclusion grounds; required FNTP-related qualifications including for PPHM structures, safety barriers, retaining structures > 6 m, earthworks, concrete and reinforced concrete engineering structures, noise barriers as well as heavily trafficked pavements and asphalt surfacings.
zuschlagskriterien: Price 40%; technical quality 40% with sub-criteria: construction schedule/phasing/programme 10%, schedule optimisation sector Taillis 5%, execution methodology 10%, human resources for preparation phase 3%, human resources for execution phase 3%, single point of contact for design and construction 4%, SOPAQ 5%; sustainable development 20% with sub-criteria: professional integration 5%, SOPRE 5%, modelling of environmental assessment 5%, evidence for the SEVE report 5%.
auftraggeber: Conseil départemental Loire Atlantique, 3 quai Ceineray, 44041 Nantes, France, Contact: MENARD Michel, E-Mail: contactmarchespublics@loire-atlantique.fr, Website: https://www.loire-atlantique.fr, Procurement platform: http://marches.loire-atlantique.fr
notes: Mandatory site visit; tenders without a visit are inadmissible. Variants are permitted. Execution period from 01.03.2027 to 03.12.2029. Electronic submission required. The notice mentions engineering structures only in general terms, without technical details on individual bridges or special structures.
